description: A sharing grant: the space's authority says what one DID may do with part of a space. POSITIVE-ONLY -- there is no deny field, and an exception is made by a narrower space -- and stored IN the space, so the record is the truth and a token is only a cache.

main.description: Readable by the issuer and the subject, and by nobody else: who is shared with is not the relay's business.

space.description: The space this grants something in.

subject.description: Who it is for: a DID, never a handle. A role is a membership lookup at read time, not a property of the subject.

selectors.description: Flat scope: a whole collection, or one exact record. Not a path, and not a subtree.

actions.description: This primitive stays view/write. Domain verbs are app-level policy over membership.

lens.description: For a view: the shape it returns. Fails closed when the lens is missing or incompatible.

retention.description: The consumer's policy, carried by the grant. Never judged by checkAccess.

consent.description: An ing.lexicon.grant.acceptance, when the subject's acceptance was demanded for this purpose.

collectionSelector.description: Everything in one collection -- or, when `fields` is given, only those fields of every record in it.

fields.description: A projection: the reader gets these fields and no others. A request that names no fields does not match this selector -- a narrower grant is never readable as a wider one.

recordSelector.description: One exact record, as it was read -- or, when `fields` is given, only those fields of it.

fields.description: A projection: the reader gets these fields and no others. A request that names no fields does not match this selector.

lensRef.description: The shape a view returns: an NSID pinned to the CID it was read at, so a reader knows what it was promised.

retention.description: What the consumer of a view may do with what it is given.
